_note2: Copy this template and name it 'settings.json' and adjust.
_note3: All files always live in the project folder (the folder of the python script).
_note4: All keys are optional; missing values use the defaults.
_note7: Comments must also follow the JSON format.
user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36
_schedule: --- Schedule: the script is started every hour (install_task.ps1); a check is done every N hours ---
_check_anchor_hour: hour of day (0-23) the grid starts from; 6 hours from 5 -> checks at 05, 11, 17, 23
_intensive_check_interval_hours: 0 = off; N = a webpage with a change is checked again after N hours (only it); without a new change it waits for the next regular check. Must be smaller than check_interval_hours
_mail: --- Mail sent by the script; SMTP password in secrets.json (template: secrets.example.json) ---
_mail_mode: none = the script sends no mail, script = send the daily report by SMTP after each check
_mail_condition: always = after every check, on_change = only if a change or an error was detected
_dev_mode: --- enabled = true: show a terminal window also for windowless scheduled runs; keep_open_after_run_seconds: pause before the window closes (also for manual starts, 0 = no pause) ---
